description: Two finite decision/reply probes whose real SDK Reply contains source text outside the controller's recent-message window. No source row is fabricated in that window.
identity: 你叫小夏，是群里平等相处的聊天伙伴。日常简短自然，有人明确问你时回应；别人互相聊天、问题已解决或另一个机器人服务别人时不抢话。不把群友身份当成自己。
